45.official: You make a pretty convincing yakuza.

47.literal: This should put Kazama-san's mind at ease a little, too.
47.official: That should put Kazama-san's mind at ease a bit.

49.literal: What are you talking about? These are such ridiculous times, aren't they?
49.official: Please. You see the times we're living in?

50.literal: You'd be a fool not to enjoy it. Use your head a little...
50.official: You'd be crazy not to enjoy all this, bro! Learn to use your head a bit.

51.literal: As for when Kazama-san gets out of prison—

52.official: Once the new year rolls around,

53.literal: By then I'll have gotten a bit more skilled myself.
53.official: I'll try to learn a few new tricks by then.

54.literal: Then start by changing that shabby getup of yours.
54.official: Yeah? How about we start with those rags you're wearing?

55.literal: Even Kazama-san always wears plain clothes, doesn't he?
55.official: Besides, Kazama-san never wore flashy clothes.

56.literal: Come on, that man is the family's lieutenant (wakagashira)...
56.official: You do realize he's the family captain, right?

57.literal: He's the number two of the Dojima Family, you know?
57.official: Number two in the whole Dojima operation?

58.literal: So that car you bought recently was for that "show" too?
58.official: So that fancy new car you bought was just "business"?

61.literal: ...Alright, let's hit Pink Street for a change.
61.official: What say we mix things up, hit Pink Street tonight? I know a nice little spot over there.

62.literal: You got some kind of problem?
62.official: What's yer problem, bro? You got a... a problem?

63.literal: We're having an important talk here!
63.official: We're in the middle of some... 'portant business!

65.literal: What do you mean, 'old man,' you jerk!

66.literal: What a pain. Let's take a different road.
66.official: It's not worth the trouble. Let's take a different road.

67.literal: You've got nothing to do with this, so butt out!!

68.literal: Uh, huh...? What on earth am I...?

69.literal: Let's see, I was at a bar watching a music program...
69.official: I remember watching music videos at that bar...

70.literal: and then which idol you like and stuff—
70.official: Then we got to talking about which idols we liked...

71.official: Then we got to talking about which idols we liked...

72.literal: Right, right, and then my Shoko-chan...
72.official: Yeah, then some smartass started making fun of poor, sweet Shoko-chan

73.literal: Ugh, my head's throbbing and I can't remember.
73.official: Rgh, my head's throbbing. I can't remember past that.

74.official: I think you two have had enough for tonight. Go home.

75.literal: Sorry about that. My, what a kind young man you are...
75.official: Oof, thanks. You're awful considerate for a kid your age.

76.literal: Heh, isn't that exactly why people flock here?

77.literal: Folks who got rich off the recent boom,

78.literal: a bunch of guys who are nothing but walking greed.

79.literal: Those guys craving booze and women—

80.literal: Well now, clumsy as you are, you actually get it, huh.

81.literal: See me in a new light now?

82.literal: Heh, what, you doubting what I say?

83.literal: Hmm, I'd like to believe you, though.

84.literal: Don't say stuff like that... Here, some pocket money.

85.literal: You've become quite the big shot somewhere along the way, huh, Nishiki.

86.literal: Staying connected with women is what matters.

87.literal: Listen up. The senior guys above us in the family...

88.official: One look and anybody with eyes can tell they're yakuza, and not the fun kind.

89.literal: So when I go drinking with the senior guys...
89.official: So, if you show up with a pack of girls every time the bosses invite you drinking, they remember you.
